description: Unique FAA aircraft registration tail number
Scheduled flight date of target flight
Published flight number of target flight
Scheduled departure timestamp in UTC
Scheduled arrival timestamp of preceding flight in UTC
Arrival delay of preceding flight leg (difference between actual and scheduled gate arrival)
Departure delay of preceding flight leg
Binary indicator whether preceding flight arrived >= 15 minutes late
Binary indicator whether preceding flight departed >= 15 minutes late
Scheduled ground turnaround buffer between preceding scheduled arrival and next scheduled departure
Estimated remaining turnaround buffer after absorbing preceding flight arrival delay
Binary flag indicating whether preceding arrival delay exceeds scheduled turnaround buffer (PREV_ARR_DELAY > SCHEDULED_BUFFER)
Operating airline code of target flight
Origin / turnaround station airport code for target flight
Destination airport code for target flight
Scheduled non-stop flight distance
Scheduled local departure hour of target flight
Day of the week of scheduled departure
Month of scheduled departure
Count of delayed flights (ARR_DEL15=1) completed by this aircraft on the same operating day prior to target flight
Count of consecutive delayed flights (up to 3) immediately preceding target flight on the same day
Sum of arrival delay minutes across all flights operated by this aircraft on the same day prior to target flight
Proportion of prior flights today that arrived delayed (0.0 when target flight is first of the day)
Binary classification target: 1 if target flight arrival delay >= 15 minutes, 0 otherwise
Continuous regression target: actual arrival delay minutes of target flight
